Izofiter

Izofiter is a Vilnius-based industrial insulation company serving projects across Europe. Its team provides thermal and acoustic insulation for pipes, tanks, and industrial equipment.

Website overview
The site presents Izofiter’s services, safety credentials, and European operations in Lithuanian, English, and Russian.
Visitor journeys
Prospective clients can explore the company’s capabilities and get in touch about a project. Job seekers have a dedicated careers section.
